title: DeepSeek reasoning joins the text API
summary:
DeepSeek reasoning was added to the text API, alongside OpenRouter routing changes and the removal of an OpenAI input check.

A `deepseek-reasoner` handler requests DeepSeek's reasoning model. The DeepSeek generator uses the selected model and records reasoning content when the provider returns it.

The text API no longer applies its 56,000-character input check to the `openai` model.

OpenRouter requests map supported aliases to provider model IDs and fall back to `deepseek/deepseek-chat` for unknown aliases. The text server handles structured OpenRouter errors; a standalone Cloudflare Flux.1 Schnell image-generation test script was also added.

highlights.title: DeepSeek reasoning model
highlights.text: Request DeepSeek's reasoning model with `deepseek-reasoner`. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=deepseek-reasoner).
